name: laqi-unit-stock-manager
description: Asset linting for Laqi Unit Stock Manager for WooCommerce. Plain admin CSS is enqueued directly and needs no build. Adding blocks/React/SCSS? Create assets/src/index.js and add back the build/start scripts — see buildScriptsComment.
buildScriptsComment: There are deliberately no build/start scripts. Both CI workflows key off the mere presence of scripts.build (quality.yml runs `npm run build --if-present`, release.yml runs it when the script exists), so shipping `wp-scripts build assets/src/index.js` with no assets/src fails both on a freshly scaffolded plugin. @wordpress/scripts itself was removed on 2026-09-01: this plugin compiles nothing, and its webpack tree carried the bulk of the repository's Dependabot alerts on its own. So adding a build back is three steps rather than one: add a real entry point, reinstall @wordpress/scripts, then add "build": "wp-scripts build assets/src/index.js --output-path=build" and "start": "wp-scripts start assets/src/index.js --output-path=build". Lint does not need it either way. eslint.config.cjs, .prettierrc.js and .stylelintrc.json now hold the config it used to supply implicitly.
overridesComment: There is no TypeScript in a scaffolded plugin. typescript is pulled in by the ESLint chain, and every consumer declares an open-ended peer range (>=4, >=4.2.0), so npm resolves the newest major. TypeScript 7 removed the TypeFlags export ts-api-utils reads, so the @typescript-eslint plugin throws while the config loads and `npm run lint:js` dies before reading a file — reporting nothing about the code rather than no problems. Pinned to the 5.x line @typescript-eslint 6 supports.
